hal.name: IWDG_ENABLE_WRITE_ACCESS
hal.brief: 向 KR 寄存器写入 IWDG_KEY_WRITE_ACCESS_ENABLE 键值, 使能对 IWDG_PR 与 IWDG_RLR 寄存器的写访问。

hal.name: IS_IWDG_PRESCALER
hal.sig:
#define IS_IWDG_PRESCALER(__PRESCALER__)      (((__PRESCALER__) == IWDG_PRESCALER_4)  || \
                                               ((__PRESCALER__) == IWDG_PRESCALER_8)  || \
                                               ((__PRESCALER__) == IWDG_PRESCALER_16) || \
                                               ((__PRESCALER__) == IWDG_PRESCALER_32) || \
                                               ((__PRESCALER__) == IWDG_PRESCALER_64) || \
                                               ((__PRESCALER__) == IWDG_PRESCALER_128)|| \
                                               ((__PRESCALER__) == IWDG_PRESCALER_256))
hal.brief: 校验 IWDG 预分频系数是否为 4/8/16/32/64/128/256 之一

retval.desc: 校验通过返回 1, 否则返回 0

hal.src:
#define IS_IWDG_PRESCALER(__PRESCALER__)      (((__PRESCALER__) == IWDG_PRESCALER_4)  || \
                                               ((__PRESCALER__) == IWDG_PRESCALER_8)  || \
                                               ((__PRESCALER__) == IWDG_PRESCALER_16) || \
                                               ((__PRESCALER__) == IWDG_PRESCALER_32) || \
                                               ((__PRESCALER__) == IWDG_PRESCALER_64) || \
                                               ((__PRESCALER__) == IWDG_PRESCALER_128)|| \
                                               ((__PRESCALER__) == IWDG_PRESCALER_256))

hal.name: IS_IWDG_RELOAD
hal.brief: 校验 IWDG 重载值不超过 IWDG_RLR_RL 掩码(12 位, 最大 0xFFF)

retval.desc: 校验通过返回 1, 否则返回 0

hal.name: IWDG_DISABLE_WRITE_ACCESS
hal.brief: 向密钥寄存器 KR 写入 IWDG_KEY_WRITE_ACCESS_DISABLE, 关闭 IWDG 寄存器的写访问(恢复写保护, 防止误写预分频/重载寄存器)

params.name: __HANDLE__
params.desc: IWDG 句柄(IWDG_HandleTypeDef 指针, 取 Instance->KR 写入)

notes: 与使能写访问(写入 IWDG_KEY_WRITE_ACCESS_ENABLE, 0x5555)成对使用; 初始化完成前必须先写 0x5555 解除写保护
